AI Overview
In the 12th DIMACS Implementation Challenge for the Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (VRPTW), inter-node distances and travel times are computed as the Euclidean distance from location coordinates and then truncated to one decimal place (rather than rounded to the nearest integer).
